reason: Audit replay, fallback, finalization and tests for a concrete current consumer and remove redundant machinery.
Trace every session/terminal field and error across proto, service, actor and local adapter.
Check no second registry, projection calculation, frame decoder, terminal parser or test download path was introduced.
Verify source policy, Unix hosted behavior and honest Windows compile/unsupported evidence.
Verify stable kinds, domain conversions, bounds and exact-result operation replay.
Verify semantic snapshot/delta equivalence, safe sequence handling and pre-allocation resource admission.
Verify PTY drain cannot be blocked by attachments and finalization/locks are deterministic.
Verify only SessionActor can terminate the root child and detach/drop remains non-destructive.
Verify same-UID peer admission, unary strictness, duplex state validation and connection fault isolation.
Verify live session/terminal/replay data is never persisted or logged.
Check local attach shares the exact SessionService/lease and never self-dials or bypasses occupied/takeover.
Check tmux/Herdr use one generic terminal path and reconnect state stays host-authoritative.
Review actor/driver wait and mutex lifetimes against the prior deadlock class.
Check implementation matches the exact pre-task code boundary and all declared exclusions.
